#!/bin/bash
TARGETS="10.20.0.11 10.40.0.10"
PORTS="22 80 443 8080 5432 3306 1433 1521 27017 8000 8081 8443 9000 9090 9200 9443"
for ip in $TARGETS; do
  echo "Scanning $ip..."
  for port in $PORTS; do
    timeout 1 bash -c "cat < /dev/null > /dev/tcp/$ip/$port" 2>/dev/null && echo "  $ip:$port open"
  done
done
